TermTranslation.definition: One of 2 genes that normally help stop cell growth. If they are abnormal they increase the risk of getting breast cancer or other cancers

TermTranslation.term: â wîhtimâchâpiyich âyânischâsîwin awân utûtûshimihch châ nihtâuchiniyich kâ muwâyich âhkusiwiniyiu
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐋ ᐐᐦᑎᒫᒑᐱᔨᒡ ᐋᔮᓂᔅᒑᓰᐎᓐ ᐊᐙᓐ ᐅᑑᑑᔑᒥᐦᒡ ᒑ ᓂᐦᑖᐅᒋᓂᔨᒡ ᑳ ᒧᐙᔨᒡ ᐋᐦᑯᓯᐎᓂᔨᐤ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: the gene tells that cancer will grow in someone’s breast
